subject: Explicit close-safe latency, session-dependency area, CoTwilight yield and uncertainty/authority serialization metrics
tests: Measure CoCloseSafeLatency+ without equating low latency with correct closure
Measure CoSessionDependencyArea+ as foreground/provider dependence over CoTime rather than raw session count
Measure CoTwilightYield+ as reusable verified delta/negative-knowledge/successor value produced during CoTwilight+
Keep PARALLELIZE_UNCERTAINTY__SERIALIZE_AUTHORITY as a control relation rather than a blanket concurrency command
expected_benefit: Make attention-time-to-independence and CoTwilight productivity inspectable without turning one metric into a universal score.
risks: Metrics can become targets and distort lifecycle decisions
Close-safe optimization can reward premature externalization if evidence quality is ignored
wake_conditions: RickBar or CoFleet needs explicit close-safe/session-dependency projections
Measured provider-session dependency remains high after virtual-first routing
A lifecycle controller begins optimizing session closure without proof-quality dimensions
